newsitem.title: SPAIN: CYCLING-ZUELLE LEADS SWISS CLEAN-SWEEP IN TOUR OF SPAIN.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ZUELLE LEADS SWISS CLEAN-SWEEP IN TOUR OF SPAIN.

text.p: Switzerland's Alex Zuelle won the Tour of Spain cycle race on Sunday, topping the overall standings ahead of compatriots Laurent Dufaux and Tony Rominger.
Zuelle took a lead of over six minutes going into the 22nd and last stage -- a 165 km stretch which started and ended in Madrid and was won by Tom Steels of Belgium.
Zuelle's task had been made less complicated when Miguel Indurain, five-times Tour de France winner, dropped out nine days ago after being left behind in the mountains for two days in succession.
It was a first Tour of Spain victory for Zuelle, who captured the overall lead 12 days ago after a time-trial.
